title: Exposure
text:
Exposure is a debuff which reduces resistances against all three elemental damage types.


== Mechanics ==
Exposure that is applied to enemies will lower their elemental resistances by the magnitude applied to them. === Using with Penetration ===
Damage Penetration normally applies to Resistances above 0%, so if the Enemy has 0% resistances or less, then penetration does nothing. However, by using Leopold's ApplauseLeopold's ApplauseEmbroidered GlovesEnergy Shield: (56-70)Requires Level 52, 64 Int(60-100)% increased Energy Shield+(60-100) to maximum Mana(10-15)% increased Rarity of Items foundDamage Penetrates 10% Elemental ResistancesYour Hits can Penetrate Elemental Resistances down to a minimum of -50%"Keep smiling. The deepest cut comes not from insults, but from false praise.", you can reduce an enemy's resistances below 0%, and still utilize Penetration, provided the enemy doesn't have less than -49% Elemental Resistances.


=== Enemy Rarity ===
Enemy Rarity can affect the magnitude of Exposure applied to them.

No Changes for Normal Enemies
15% less Exposure effect on Magic Enemies.
30% less Exposure effect on Rare Enemies.
50% less Exposure effect on Unique Enemies.


=== Base Value ===
The base value of exposure can be modified through various means (e.g. Stripped Defences), and stats that increase/decrease exposure effect apply to this modified base value.
